features.title: PCI DSS via processors (legal claim)
prerequisites: Card payments via Stripe/PayPal/MercadoPago only — Payverge stores no PANs

evidence.note: Card data collected via Stripe Checkout, not stored by Payverge.

Structural SAQ-A journey: the guest payment request binds no PAN/CVV fields, so forged card data is dropped (never echoed/stored), and card payments are a processor redirect (return_url/cancel_url). Proven live by the no-PAN release journey. Broader PCI attestation remains counsel-owned (P3).

features.title: Encryption of sensitive data at rest (legal claim — not currently published)

evidence.note: App-level at-rest encryption covers plugin credentials only (AES-GCM envelope keyed by PLUGIN_SECRET_KEY); the Postgres volume is not app-encrypted, so the broad at-rest claim stays unpublished (keys empty).

Internal security-review process claim. The review write-ups are private and not published in this repository; no third-party penetration test is claimed. Reclassified beta (evidence-doc); narrow copy to 'internal reviews'.
